description: kube-platform Renovate config. Every pinned version in this repo is either carried by a '# renovate:' annotation (see customManagers) or found by one of the enabled built-in managers. Argo CD syncs this repo's protected branch straight into live clusters, so nothing auto-merges here - every upgrade arrives as its own reviewable pull request.

kubernetes.description: Plain, non-templated manifests carrying a container image. Scoped deliberately: everything else under platform/ is a Helm template, which this manager cannot parse.

customManagers.description: Any version carrying a '# renovate:' annotation on the line above it - platform-versions/values.yaml and every Argo CD Application targetRevision. registryUrl (Helm repositories) and versioning are optional; omit versioning to take the datasource default.

packageRules.description: RKE2 tags are semver plus an RKE2 build counter (v1.36.2+rke2r1), which no built-in versioning scheme parses.

Pin the wildcard subchart ranges in Chart.yaml. A '2.*' range is never out of date, so Renovate can only begin tracking these once they resolve to an exact version - which also matches how every other chart version in this repo is pinned.
Minor and major upgrades change platform behaviour - label them so they are not skimmed.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Only fires for ecosystems GitHub raises advisories for, which is little of what this repo tracks. Kept so a security fix is labelled and unbatched if one ever does arrive.
